rec.reason: This is a client order/project container ticket for Veynou (Sectionfy), not a single element. It bundles several separate sections (CP Model View, CP Product Slider, PDP Farbvarianten, PDP Product Thumbnails, CP Spotlight), each tracked in its own linked Asana task. The comments are mostly delivery chatter: access and metafield permission errors, theme merge coordination, and client feedback rounds. The reusable specs belong in those linked tickets, so recording the bundle as one element would blur several distinct ones.
